title: Checkist · Траты
description: Траты, доходы, места и способы оплаты семьи из базы; валюты не складываются — выберите валюту

list.name: household
list.label: Семья
list.query: SELECT 'Без семьи' AS __text, '0' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT name, id::text FROM accounts_household

list.name: currency
list.label: Валюта
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT currency_id FROM receipts_receipt WHERE NOT hidden

panels.title: Потрачено
panels.description: Σ итогов трат в выбранной валюте; скрытые платежи не входят

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(r.total), 0) FROM receipts_receipt r LEFT JOIN accounts_membership m ON m.user_id = r.owner_id WHERE NOT r.hidden AND r.currency_id = '$currency' AND COALESCE(m.household_id, 0)::text IN ($household) AND $__timeFilter(r.purchased_on)

SELECT count(*) FROM receipts_receipt r LEFT JOIN accounts_membership m ON m.user_id = r.owner_id WHERE NOT r.hidden AND r.currency_id = '$currency' AND COALESCE(m.household_id, 0)::text IN ($household) AND $__timeFilter(r.purchased_on)

SELECT COALESCE(sum(income), 0) FROM (SELECT date_trunc('month', i.received_on) AS month, sum(i.amount) AS income FROM incomes_income i LEFT JOIN accounts_membership m ON m.user_id = i.owner_id WHERE i.currency_id = '$currency' AND COALESCE(m.household_id, 0)::text IN ($household) AND $__timeFilter(i.received_on) GROUP BY 1) i

panels.title: Отложено
panels.description: Доход минус потрачено; пусто — дохода нет

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT sum(income) FROM (SELECT date_trunc('month', i.received_on) AS month, sum(i.amount) AS income FROM incomes_income i LEFT JOIN accounts_membership m ON m.user_id = i.owner_id WHERE i.currency_id = '$currency' AND COALESCE(m.household_id, 0)::text IN ($household) AND $__timeFilter(i.received_on) GROUP BY 1) i) - COALESCE((SELECT sum(spent) FROM (SELECT date_trunc('month', r.purchased_on) AS month, sum(r.total) AS spent FROM receipts_receipt r LEFT JOIN accounts_membership m ON m.user_id = r.owner_id WHERE NOT r.hidden AND r.currency_id = '$currency' AND COALESCE(m.household_id, 0)::text IN ($household) AND $__timeFilter(r.purchased_on) GROUP BY 1) s), 0)

SELECT r.purchased_on::timestamp AS time, sum(r.total) AS "Потрачено" FROM receipts_receipt r LEFT JOIN accounts_membership m ON m.user_id = r.owner_id WHERE NOT r.hidden AND r.currency_id = '$currency' AND COALESCE(m.household_id, 0)::text IN ($household) AND $__timeFilter(r.purchased_on) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: По месяцам и категориям
panels.description: Строки чеков по корневой категории товара (у строки без товара — своя категория); скидка на весь чек не распределена

targets.rawSql: WITH RECURSIVE roots AS (SELECT id, name FROM catalog_category WHERE parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.id, roots.name FROM catalog_category c JOIN roots ON c.parent_id = roots.id) SELECT date_trunc('month', r.purchased_on)::timestamp AS time, COALESCE(roots.name, 'Без категории') AS metric, sum(l.amount - l.discount_amount) AS value FROM receipts_receiptline l JOIN receipts_receipt r ON r.id = l.receipt_id LEFT JOIN accounts_membership m ON m.user_id = r.owner_id LEFT JOIN catalog_product p ON p.id = l.product_id LEFT JOIN catalog_genericproduct g ON g.id = p.generic_id LEFT JOIN roots ON roots.id = COALESCE(g.category_id, l.category_id) WHERE NOT r.hidden AND r.currency_id = '$currency' AND COALESCE(m.household_id, 0)::text IN ($household) AND $__timeFilter(r.purchased_on) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

WITH RECURSIVE roots AS (SELECT id, name FROM catalog_category WHERE parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.id, roots.name FROM catalog_category c JOIN roots ON c.parent_id = roots.id) SELECT COALESCE(roots.name, 'Без категории') AS category, sum(l.amount - l.discount_amount) AS spent FROM receipts_receiptline l JOIN receipts_receipt r ON r.id = l.receipt_id LEFT JOIN accounts_membership m ON m.user_id = r.owner_id LEFT JOIN catalog_product p ON p.id = l.product_id LEFT JOIN catalog_genericproduct g ON g.id = p.generic_id LEFT JOIN roots ON roots.id = COALESCE(g.category_id, l.category_id) WHERE NOT r.hidden AND r.currency_id = '$currency' AND COALESCE(m.household_id, 0)::text IN ($household) AND $__timeFilter(r.purchased_on) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Доход, потрачено и отложено по месяцам
panels.description: Месяц без дохода — пропуск, а не ноль

targets.rawSql: WITH i AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', i.received_on) AS month, sum(i.amount) AS income FROM incomes_income i LEFT JOIN accounts_membership m ON m.user_id = i.owner_id WHERE i.currency_id = '$currency' AND COALESCE(m.household_id, 0)::text IN ($household) AND $__timeFilter(i.received_on) GROUP BY 1), s AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', r.purchased_on) AS month, sum(r.total) AS spent FROM receipts_receipt r LEFT JOIN accounts_membership m ON m.user_id = r.owner_id WHERE NOT r.hidden AND r.currency_id = '$currency' AND COALESCE(m.household_id, 0)::text IN ($household) AND $__timeFilter(r.purchased_on) GROUP BY 1) SELECT COALESCE(i.month, s.month)::timestamp AS time, i.income AS "Доход", COALESCE(s.spent, 0) AS "Потрачено", i.income - COALESCE(s.spent, 0) AS "Отложено" FROM i FULL JOIN s ON s.month = i.month ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(mm.brand_name, ''), NULLIF(st.name, ''), 'Магазин №' || st.id, 'Без места') AS place, sum(r.total) AS spent FROM receipts_receipt r LEFT JOIN accounts_membership m ON m.user_id = r.owner_id LEFT JOIN stores_store s0 ON s0.id = r.store_id LEFT JOIN stores_store st ON st.id = COALESCE(s0.merged_into_id, s0.id) LEFT JOIN stores_merchant mm ON mm.id = st.merchant_id WHERE NOT r.hidden AND r.currency_id = '$currency' AND COALESCE(m.household_id, 0)::text IN ($household) AND $__timeFilter(r.purchased_on) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT CASE r.payment_method WHEN '' THEN 'Не указан' WHEN 'kaspi_gold' THEN 'Kaspi Gold' WHEN 'forte' THEN 'ForteBank' WHEN 'cash' THEN 'Наличные' WHEN 'crypto' THEN 'Криптовалюта' WHEN 'card' THEN 'Другая карта' ELSE r.payment_method END AS method, sum(r.total) AS spent FROM receipts_receipt r LEFT JOIN accounts_membership m ON m.user_id = r.owner_id WHERE NOT r.hidden AND r.currency_id = '$currency' AND COALESCE(m.household_id, 0)::text IN ($household) AND $__timeFilter(r.purchased_on) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Источники
panels.description: Выписка — по комментарию « · Выписка …», как в выгрузке

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN r.source = 'photo' THEN 'Фото чека' WHEN r.note ~ '·\s*Выписка[^·]*$' THEN 'Выписка' ELSE 'Вручную' END AS source, sum(r.total) AS spent FROM receipts_receipt r LEFT JOIN accounts_membership m ON m.user_id = r.owner_id WHERE NOT r.hidden AND r.currency_id = '$currency' AND COALESCE(m.household_id, 0)::text IN ($household) AND $__timeFilter(r.purchased_on) GROUP BY 1
